name: git-workflow
description: Git workflow plugin with practical guidance from real repository state for commit readiness, Conventional Commit drafting, staged-change hygiene, and template-aware hosted service change description or hosted service change description body drafting.

interface.shortDescription: Commit readiness, Conventional Commit drafting, and template-aware change description body drafting from real repository state.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the real repository state and decide whether this change set is ready for one commit or should be split before committing.
Draft a Conventional Commit message from the actual staged diff and explain the chosen type.
Prepare Git-contained change-description text that preserves the repository template or uses a safe fallback structure, then branch into repository-specific template handling when needed.
